'''''Yar''''' was a [[Star Galleon-class frigate]] present at [[Destreg Spaceport]] that was present when [[K'Armyn Viraxo]]'s personal [[Personal Luxury Yacht 3000/Legends|yacht]], the ''[[Highroller]]'', was destroyed by [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace]] and [[Emon Azzameen]]. However, K'Armyn had got wind of this and used the yacht as a trap against the Azzameens. Despite this, both Ace and Emon escaped the ambush by destroying all of the Bounty Hunters. Her cargo was [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]].
